[[File:Fusing_Pen.png|thumb|Fusing pen]]
A '''fusing pen''' was a welding tool which was used to slice together the wires of a control board.

During the [[Battle of Hapes (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Hapes]] in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] attempted to use a fusing pen to slice together the wires of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon's'']] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] adjustment panel.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
